name: PhenoFabric
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: Recent commits replace bespoke/demo login UI with hosted AuthKit integration and desktop authentication commands. Actual successful authentication and two-node I/O were not executed here.
concerns: Adopting hosted authentication is a reuse decision, not completion of local/LAN/WAN routing.
Preserve accepted offline/local trust behavior and supported native callback/token lifecycle.
Do not copy credential values into shared handoffs.

next_actions.title: Qualify the actual authentication contract
next_actions.work: Test success, denial, cancellation, expired session, unavailable network and native callback; compare expected local/offline behavior with accepted policy.
next_actions.acceptance: No demo success, credential leak or irrecoverable login loop; actual scoped user state.

next_actions.title: Prove one real two-node path
next_actions.work: Use genuine producer/consumer endpoints and negotiated capabilities with cancellation, disconnect/reconnect and correct focus/input/output ownership.
next_actions.acceptance: End-to-end transport and effects observed; no graph-only fixture stands in for working devices.

next_actions.title: Demonstrate locality and contention behavior
next_actions.work: Choose shared-memory/local transport where supported and qualified network adapters otherwise; measure tail latency, quality and foreground impact.
next_actions.acceptance: No hidden copies/queues or unsupported capability passes; actual Mac/PC workflow proof and dependency contracts.

ecosystem_contract: PhenoShared can host reusable libraries; PhenoFabric remains responsible for the full product behavior. Shared-source changes require consumer tests on both sides.
parent_acceptance: The installed fabric completes a real multi-device workflow with safe state, recovery and measured performance.
scope_missing: actual chat receipts and read acknowledgement
